lead_raw_text:
The trigonal P-3m1 (No. 164) structure of ErMg6V crystallizes in a 2-dimensional cell containing 8 atoms, with 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Er centers in an octahedral environment of 6 Mg neighbors, while Mg and V centers each have 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Er octahedra and both Mg and V 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions.
